title: ECGFounder
paper_title: An Electrocardiogram Foundation Model Built on over 10 Million Recordings
core_mech: ECGFounder 是 RegNet/Net1D 风格的 1D CNN foundation model，以超过千万波形和 150 类监督规模为核心，不应误写为通用 Transformer SSL。
core_mech_en: 1D RegNet-style residual CNN with Squeeze-and-Excitation blocks pretrained via multi-label clinical supervision across >10 million 12-lead ECGs and 150 diagnostic categories.
input_desc: 标准化的 12 导联或适配后的任意单导联 ECG 波形
input_en: Raw multi-lead (12-lead) or lead-masked single-lead 1D ECG voltage waveform tensor
output_desc: 150 类诊断概率、通用 ECG embedding 与下游微调预测
output_en: 150-class diagnostic probability vector and general-purpose 1D ECG representation

source.title: ECGFounder
notes: Atlas bdsp-core/ECGFounder URL returned 404. The paper authors' official implementation is PKUDigitalHealth/ECGFounder, verified from its README and model card.

adapter.name: ECGFounder (Net1D architecture)
adapter.mechanism: The authors' Net1D: SAME-padded grouped 1D bottlenecks, squeeze-excitation, residual downsampling, global time pooling and a task head.
limitations: Architecture-only exercise: no ten-million-recording pretraining, 150-label diagnostic ontology, lead-dropout pretraining or published checkpoint is included.
The default reads one synthetic waveform channel; it is not a physiological ECG or a validated single-lead disease predictor.
Original seven-stage block counts and kernel size 16 are retained, but channels are reduced and the downstream head has three synthetic classes.
No external weights are loaded. Low compute does not recreate the learned knowledge of ECGFounder.
